recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28543 unless a separate issue asks to review similar encounter short names outside Event.encounter.
issue_request: FHIR-28543 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by FHIR-I. It asked to change the Event.encounter short name from "Encounter created as part of" to "Encounter the {{title}} is part of"; the work group rejected the suggested "tied to" wording as too loose.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to git master 37f00fcff9. That commit changed source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml so Event.encounter uses the approved short name. Later spreadsheet normalization and pattern-alignment commits changed nearby XML details but preserved the approved wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists event under [logical], making source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml an active build input. Current source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml:1219 contains "Encounter the {{title}} is part of" for Event.encounter. FHIR Workflow minutes from 2020-12-07 record FHIR-28543 as Persuasive w/ Mod, and direct Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. Similar older wording remains only in release-history files or unrelated non-Event artifacts, outside this Jira's approved scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Event source already matches the final Jira resolution, and editing unrelated encounter short names would exceed the issue scope.
